name: vendor-review
title: Vendor security review pack
for_each: select id,name from vendors order by name

sections.title: Evidence reviewed
sections.sql: select name,reference,verified_by,verified_on,valid_until from evidence where vendor_id=$1 order by valid_until

sections.title: Recorded findings
sections.sql: select name,risk_score,owner,due_on,state,waived from finding_position where vendor_id=$1 order by risk_score desc

sections.title: Assessment history
sections.sql: select name,scope,state,reviewer,decided_on,next_review_on,rationale from assessments where vendor_id=$1 order by created_at

name: remediation-plan
title: Vendor remediation plan
for_each: select distinct v.id,v.name from vendors v join findings f on f.vendor_id=v.id where f.state='open'

sections.title: Actions for review
sections.note: Draft only. Review and send through your normal communication process.
sections.sql: select name,likelihood,impact,risk_score,owner,due_on,waived from finding_position where vendor_id=$1 and state='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Accepted exceptions
sections.sql: select w.name,w.reason,w.approver,w.expires_on,w.revoked from waivers w join findings f on f.id=w.finding_id where f.vendor_id=$1 order by w.expires_on

name: decision-record
title: Assessment decision record
for_each: select id,name from assessments where state<>'open'

sections.title: Frozen evidence and findings
sections.note: Point-in-time record. Later changes do not rewrite this decision. Operator names are recorded statements, not verified digital signatures.
sections.sql: select snapshot from assessments where id=$1
